usage: run_train.py [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--dataset {librispeech,vctk}]
                    [--max_steps MAX_STEPS] [--run_name RUN_NAME]
                    [--alpha ALPHA] [--w_spk W_SPK] [--w_rec W_REC]
                    [--w_intra W_INTRA] [--w_agg W_AGG] [--w_rank W_RANK]
                    [--w_ceiling W_CEILING] [--w_kagg W_KAGG] [--w_att W_ATT]
                    [--w_tgt W_TGT] [--w_away W_AWAY] [--w_energy W_ENERGY]
                    [--eot_prob EOT_PROB] [--seed SEED]
                    [--train_subset_size TRAIN_SUBSET_SIZE]
                    [--stage1_steps STAGE1_STEPS]
                    [--init_checkpoint INIT_CHECKPOINT]
                    [--agg_group_size AGG_GROUP_SIZE]
                    [--rank_margin RANK_MARGIN] [--rank_k_set RANK_K_SET]
                    [--rank_k_probs RANK_K_PROBS] [--ceiling_tau CEILING_TAU]
                    [--train_objective {rank,kagg,targetshift,kagg_session,targetedk,targetedk_soft_def,targetedk_hard16_margin}]
                    [--session_pool_train_csv SESSION_POOL_TRAIN_CSV]
                    [--att_candidate_windows ATT_CANDIDATE_WINDOWS]
                    [--att_beta ATT_BETA] [--att_use_full_session]
                    [--att_tau ATT_TAU] [--att_gamma ATT_GAMMA]
                    [--att_margin_mode {hinge,logistic}]
                    [--att_selection_source {clean,defended,tele_defended}]
                    [--best_metric {speaker_sim_tel,val_k16_proxy}]
                    [--val_session_pool_csv VAL_SESSION_POOL_CSV]
                    [--val_proxy_sessions VAL_PROXY_SESSIONS]
                    [--val_proxy_selection_source {clean,defended,tele_defended}]

CloneBlock-RT training
